title: [macOS] Crash in engineCallbackOnPlatformMessage when dispatching a nil handler
body:
## Bug Description In the macOS embedder, passing `nil` to `-[FlutterEngine setMessageHandlerOnChannel:binaryMessageHandler:]` does not remove the channel entry from `_messengerHandlers`. As a result, when a platform message comes through on that channel, it calls this `nil` handler on MacOS and crashes. However, [`FlutterBinaryMessenger.h`](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/blob/9584c6713b324636289d067944a46fd6b49df14b/engine/src/flutter/shell/platform/darwin/common/framework/Headers/FlutterBinaryMessenger.h#L81-L94) says that assigning `nil` should unregister the handler: > *"Replaces any existing handler. Use a `nil` handler for unregistering the existing handler."* Note that iOS doesn't have this issue; only macOS does. There are bugs in two places: 1. `setMessageHandlerOnChannel:binaryMessageHandler:` which retains nil handlers 2. `engineCallbackOnPlatformMessage:` checks that `handlerInfo` is not null, but doesn't check `handlerInfo.handler`. ## Proposed Fix 1. In `setMessageHandlerOnChannel:binaryMessageHandler:`, remove the channel from `_messengerHandlers` if `handler == nil`. 2. In `engineCallbackOnPlatformMessage:`, verify `handlerInfo.handler` is non-nil before invoking it. #### Expected results don't call null handlers, and maybe call `binaryResponseHandler(nil)` instead? #### Actual results The engine crashes with `SEGV_ACCERR` in `-[FlutterEngine engineCallbackOnPlatformMessage:]`; see stacktrace below
Repro code sample You can repro this by unregistering a handler on the platform thread and then sending a message to that channel from Dart: **Native side:** ```objc id messenger = engine.binaryMessenger; // Register a handler, then unregister it per the API contract: [messenger setMessageHandlerOnChannel:@"repro/nil-handler" binaryMessageHandler:^(NSData* message, FlutterBinaryReply reply) { reply(nil); }]; // Unregister: [messenger setMessageHandlerOnChannel:@"repro/nil-handler" binaryMessageHandler:nil]; ``` **Dart side:** ```dart const BasicMessageChannel( 'repro/nil-handler', StringCodec(), ).send('ping'); ```
